details: Malicious package. During `pip install`, `setup.py` executed a payload that queried `ip-api.com` for the public IP and then connected to `transfer.sh`, a file-upload service used here for exfiltration, observed in a sandboxed install. The `setup.py` (1,300 KB, sha256 78c0f7d44695ed24f4ed86ddec3ecb94911fc130977d580ab824751077225a6a) is padded to an unusual size, consistent with the embedded Windows executable in the WhiteSnake family; the name sits alongside its siblings libidrequest (MAL-2024-5318) and libideeee (MAL-2024-5315). The package has been removed from PyPI.
